text: FAB speed-dial actions ("Receipt" / "Mileage"): The actions render as free-floating pills in the middle of the screen, overlapping the primary "Add receipt" button, and on desktop they sit outside the 420 dp centered container at the far right. There is no visible anchor FAB. Expected after the fix: Replace the custom pills with Paper `<FAB.Group>` (icon="plus", actions with icons `receipt` / `car`, label strings) rendered inside the Screen's absolutely-positioned overlay: `position:'absolute', right: 16, bottom: tabBarHeight + insets.bottom + 16`. On desktop constrain the overlay to the same

Bottom tab bar labels: At 390 dp the labels ("Dashboard", "Receipts", …) are clipped by the bottom edge — the 56 dp bar has no room for 24 dp icon + 12 sp label and ignores the safe-area inset. Expected after the fix: In the shared TabBar: `height: 56 + insets.bottom`, `paddingBottom: insets.bottom`, icon size 24, `labelStyle={{fontSize:12, lineHeight:16, marginTop:4}}`, and set the item container `justifyContent:'center'` so icon+label are vertically centered within the 56 dp bar.

Screen header title ("Dashboard"): The headline sits flush against the top edge on mobile and is clipped on desktop — no safe-area or top padding. Expected after the fix: In the shared `Screen` component wrap the title in `Appbar.Header` (mode="small", elevated={false}, backgroundColor theme.colors.surface) or add `paddingTop: insets.top + 8` and `paddingBottom: 16` to the header row; keep horizontal padding at 16 dp.

EmptyState block: Content is pinned to the top third leaving ~700 dp of dead space below, so the screen looks broken rather than empty. Expected after the fix: In the shared `EmptyState`, set the container to `flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', paddingHorizontal: 24` and have `Screen`'s ScrollView use `contentContainerStyle={{flexGrow: 1}}` so the block centers in the available height on both phone and desktop.

EmptyState body copy: Supporting text is rendered in a teal/secondary color, competing with the primary CTA and off-token for body text. Expected after the fix: Use `<Text variant="bodyMedium" style={{color: theme.colors.onSurfaceVariant, textAlign:'center', maxWidth: 288}}>` for the body and `variant="titleLarge"` with `color: theme.colors.onSurface` for the title; spacing: 16 dp icon→title, 8 dp title→body, 24 dp body→CTA.

"Add receipt" button: The contained button shows a stray grey outline/focus ring and is only ~195 dp wide, reading as a web focus artifact. Expected after the fix: Remove the border/outline style from the button (Paper `Button mode="contained"` only, no `style.borderWidth`, `outlineStyle:'none'` on web) and give it `contentStyle={{height: 48, paddingHorizontal: 24}}` so it reads as a proper MD3 CTA.

The stack navigator used for sub‑screens (e.g. TaxRateScreen, ExportScreen, BackupScreen, etc.) hides the BottomTabBar, preventing users from reaching other primary tabs without using the back button. Expected after the fix: Wrap each sub‑screen in a nested stack that does **not** set `tabBarVisible: false` (or `headerShown: true` only) so the bottom tab bar remains visible on all signed‑in screens. Use `screenOptions={{ tabBarStyle: { height: 56 } }}` and avoid `options={{ tabBarVisible: false }}` on sub‑screens.
